Lena Kim: Quick postmortem follow-up from the overnight degradation — model-registry errors were downstream of an auth provider throttle. We need consolidated owners for remediation and clear timelines.
Omar Ruiz: timeline recap: 01:07 UTC auth refresh spike -> 01:09 vendor 429s -> 01:11 registry 502s -> 01:20 LB health flaps. Autoscaling stabilized by 01:35.
Priya Desai: Root cause looked like many short-lived service tokens + synchronous refreshes from multiple worker fleets.
Chris Holt: Agreed. Immediate mitigations: increase client cache TTL (current=45s) to 180s, add per-client refresh mutex, and introduce refresh jitter. Low risk config change.
Marta Novak: I can own the hotfix and test harness. Proposed owners/timeline:
- Hotfix (18h): Marta (config + unit tests) + Chris (canary deploy)
- Short-term (10d): Priya (runbook + alerts + top-refreshers query), Omar (vendor escalation + logs)
- Long-term (6w): SRE (proxy circuit-breaker + fallback auth path), Product/Security (token policy review)
Omar Ruiz: Vendor update: they offered a 48h throttle relaxation but asked for a mitigation plan. I'll take the vendor run and loop in legal if needed.
Lena Kim: Alerts to add: `auth.refresh_rate_per_subject > 20 for 5m` and `modelregistry.502_rate > 5/min`. Also add a composite alert that fires when both are elevated.
Priya Desai: I'll add the monitors and a dashboard panel highlighting top 15 subjects by refresh/sec. Will include a query and runbook snippet.
Chris Holt: Hotfix config I'm going to canary: 
```
auth_client: { token_cache_ttl: 180, refresh_jitter_ms: 200-900, per_subject_mutex_ms: 2500 }
proxy: { on_429_backoff_ms: exponential(100, 5000) }
```
Marta Novak: I'll run a staging test simulating 400 clients refreshing over 8s and measure vendor 429s. Plan to run 09:00 PT tomorrow.
Omar Ruiz: Long-term asks: request vendor SLA addendum for burst handling and a documented emergency throttle exception process. I'll write the ask and share draft in 24h.
Priya Desai: Runbook items: immediate play "auth 429 -> throttle" steps, how to toggle local TTL via config, vendor escalation contacts, and postmortem checklist. ETA 7 business days for draft.
Lena Kim: Also add a retro item: identify which internal jobs cause concentrated refreshes (migration scripts, batch agents). Assign to Product infra to audit.
Chris Holt: Risk note: Increasing TTL extends exposure window for a revoked token. We'll implement a revocation webhook to invalidate caches; I'll add that as a follow-up (48h).
Marta Novak: Action items recap:
- Marta: push TTL+jitter+mutex hotfix to canary (18h) + run staging harness (24h)
- Chris: canary deploy + revocation webhook design (48h)
- Priya: runbook + alerts + dashboard (7d)
- Omar: vendor logs/SLA ask + legal loop (48-72h)
- SRE/Product: evaluate gateway circuit-breaker and signed-token option (6w)
ops-bot: Task created: "Auth-refresh hotfix + runbook" assigned to Marta Novak and Priya Desai. Due in 18 hours.
Lena Kim: Thanks everyone. We'll do a 20m sync after canary finishes. Drop blockers here. :eyes:
